stem: A bus travels 25 miles in 30 minutes. Which graph has a slope that best represents the number of miles per minute the bus travels?

options.label: A
options.text: (Graph labeled Bus Speed with axes Distance (mi) and Time (min), line increasing with points near 0,0 and 50,50)

options.label: B
options.text: (Graph labeled Bus Speed with axes Distance (mi) and Time (min), line increasing with points near 0,0 and 40,50)

options.label: C
options.text: (Graph labeled Bus Speed with axes Distance (mi) and Time (min), line increasing with points near 0,0 and 50,40)

options.label: D
options.text: (Graph labeled Bus Speed with axes Distance (mi) and Time (min), line increasing steeply to near 20,50)

visual_elements: Graph A: Bus Speed with Distance (mi) on y-axis and Time (min) on x-axis, line through (0,0) and (50,50).
Graph B: Bus Speed with Distance (mi) on y-axis and Time (min) on x-axis, line through (0,0) and about (40,50).
Graph C: Bus Speed with Distance (mi) on y-axis and Time (min) on x-axis, line through (0,0) and about (50,40).
Graph D: Bus Speed with Distance (mi) on y-axis and Time (min) on x-axis, steep line through (0,0) and about (20,50).
